scroll_list.name: set_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: Double-click a set to make it the active one. Sets from another viewer's #AO folder are used in place.

button.label: Delete
button.name: delete_btn
button.tool_tip: Move the set folder to the Trash. Only links are inside; your animations are not touched.

button.label: Use This Set
button.name: activate_btn
button.tool_tip: Make the selected set the active one

button.label: Import...
button.name: import_btn
button.tool_tip: Import the AO notecard (ZHAO-II or Oracul) or AO folder selected in your inventory window. You can also drag one onto this window.

button.label: Import from Worn HUD...
button.name: import_object_btn
button.tool_tip: Copy the animations out of a worn AO HUD or other attachment into a new set (copyable animations only; no-copy ones stay where they are)

scroll_list.name: state_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: States in bold have animations. The arrow marks the state playing now.

check_box.label: Cycle
check_box.name: cycle_check
check_box.tool_tip: Play different animations of this state: on a timer, or each time the state starts (below). Off: always the first one.

check_box.label: Random
check_box.name: random_check
check_box.tool_tip: When cycling, pick at random (never the same twice in a row) instead of in list order

check_box.label: Change only when entering the state
check_box.name: pick_on_entry_check
check_box.tool_tip: Pick the next animation (or a random one if Random is ticked) only when this state starts, and keep it for as long as the state lasts. Off: Cycle switches on the timer.

scroll_list.name: anim_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: Drag animations here from your inventory. Double-click to preview on your avatar (only you see it).

button.label: Remove
button.name: remove_btn
button.tool_tip: Remove the animation from this state. Only the link is removed; the animation stays in your inventory.

button.label: Preview
button.name: preview_btn
button.tool_tip: Play the selected animation on your avatar, locally (nobody else sees it)

combo_box.name: assign_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: State to put the selected unsorted animation in

button.label: Assign
button.name: assign_btn
button.tool_tip: Use the selected animation for this state (you can add it to several states)

check_box.label: Override sits
check_box.name: sit_override_check
check_box.tool_tip: Replace the sit on objects with this set's sit animations

check_box.label: Smart sit
check_box.name: smart_sit_check
check_box.tool_tip: Do not override sits on poseballs and furniture that animate you themselves

check_box.label: No stands in mouselook
check_box.name: no_mouselook_check
check_box.tool_tip: Let the default stand play while in mouselook

check_box.label: No stands while typing
check_box.name: no_typing_check
check_box.tool_tip: Pause stands while you type, so the typing animation shows

check_box.label: Stop system animations
check_box.name: stop_system_check
check_box.tool_tip: Stop the built-in animation of each state while this set's replacement plays, so it cannot show through (given back as soon as the AO lets go). Turn off if your animations are made to blend with the built-ins.

check_box.label: Always animations
check_box.name: always_check
check_box.tool_tip: Play the Always list (body fixes: hands, feet, deformers) the whole time the AO is on, whatever else plays

check_box.label: Idles every
check_box.name: idle_check
check_box.tool_tip: Now and then play a random animation from the Idle list in place of the stand, then go back to the stands

spinner.name: idle_min_spin
spinner.tool_tip: Shortest wait between idles, in seconds

spinner.name: idle_max_spin
spinner.tool_tip: Longest wait between idles, in seconds (the wait is random in between)

spinner.name: idle_cap_spin
spinner.tool_tip: Longest an idle plays, in seconds (looped idles always stop here)

check_box.label: also when sitting
check_box.name: idle_sit_check
check_box.tool_tip: Idles may also replace the sit override

check_box.label: Step aside for poses, dances and poseballs
check_box.name: pause_scripts_check
check_box.tool_tip: While a script animation (collar pose, dance HUD, poseball, furniture) moves your hips or legs, stands and other idle states pause

check_box.label: Start walks and stands without waiting for the server
check_box.name: predict_check
check_box.tool_tip: Use your movement keys to start walk/run/stand/fly/hover replacements one round trip early (less flicker)

check_box.label: Stop built-in animations that leak through
check_box.name: stop_defaults_check
check_box.tool_tip: Also stop the built-in hover, fly, turn, landing, jump and sit animations while a replacement plays (avoids stray arm and leg poses)

check_box.label: Keep head still
check_box.name: keep_head_check
check_box.tool_tip: No look-at head turning while the AO plays: your avatar's head does not follow the camera or mouse, and other viewers are sent no look-at target. Back to normal when the AO is off or paused.

check_box.label: Accept @slao commands from my objects
check_box.name: accept_commands_check
check_box.tool_tip: Collars, HUDs and furniture you own can pause or control the AO with llOwnerSay("@slao=n") and similar. See the documentation for the command list.

check_box.label: Detect a worn scripted AO
check_box.name: detect_scripted_check
check_box.tool_tip: Offer to pause this AO while a worn scripted AO HUD is fighting it. Off: no offers, and a scripted AO you chose to defer to no longer pauses this AO.

check_box.label: Walk backwards facing forward
check_box.name: back_facing_check
check_box.tool_tip: On: moving backwards keeps your avatar facing forward and the AO plays its Walking Backwards animation (running: only in your own view). Off: your avatar turns round to face where it is going, walking or running, and the AO plays its forward Walking animation. Works with the AO off (then Off leaves the viewer default).

check_box.label: Allow swimming
check_box.name: swim_check
check_box.tool_tip: In deep water float at the surface, dive with crouch (C / Page Down), rise back when released, swim up with E / Page Up, and walk out onto land. Uses flying, so not where flying is blocked. Works with the AO off, but the swim animations come from the AO set.

button.label: Remembered choices...
button.name: ignored_btn
button.tool_tip: Animations from other objects that never pause the AO (added with "Don't pause for this"), and the scripted AOs you chose to pause for or keep alongside. Forget one to be asked again.
